_comment: Ordered asset bases per tier. Two orthogonal axes: RISK (main vs high-risk, which decides the repo) and SIZE (jsDelivr hard-403s any file over 20 MB — 'File size exceeded the configured limit of 20 MB' — so those games must lead with raw.githubusercontent, which serves up to 100 MB). {A} main, {B} main+big, {X} high-risk (own repo so a takedown can't break the rest), {Y} high-risk+big, {C} covers, {R} shared runtimes. Never bake absolute URLs into games.json: swapping a base must never require a rebuild.
